accept.js.forms: only the coherence catalog's own patterns (src/analyzer/coherence/catalog.ts) match: archrift has no forms

rules.name: no-cycles
rules.description: no files import each other in a circle

rules.name: layers-point-down
rules.description: runtime imports point down the layers: cli, viewer, server, analyzer, core

rules.name: node-side-without-viewer
rules.description: the command line, server and analyzers never load the viewer, directly or through other files: the npm package builds them without it (tsconfig.build.json); only the viewer's URL format is shared

rules.name: functions-small-logic
rules.description: functions outside the viewer stay under complexity 10 (older code is above: split what you touch)

rules.name: functions-small-ui
rules.description: viewer functions stay under complexity 20 (older code is above: split what you touch)
